standard_prerequisites.name: Etale localization of quasi-finite parts
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the simultaneous etale neighbourhood normalizing all field extensions and decompositions.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finite etale one-point iso
standard_prerequisites.use: Yields the local isomorphism W_i -> V_i from the residue-field computation.

core_obligations: Reduce to W separated by an etale cover and shrink U etale-locally so all kappa(z_i)/kappa(u), kappa(w_i)/kappa(u) are purely inseparable with disjoint decompositions.
Normalize the decompositions so f maps W_i into V_i, check f_i finite etale with kappa(z_i) = kappa(w_i), and conclude the local isomorphism.
Shrink U so the isomorphism is global.
proof_roadmap: Localize etale-locally to normalize residue fields, split off the finite parts, force f_i to map W_i to V_i, apply the one-point finite-etale iso, and shrink to globalize.
difficulty_reason: Multi-step localization dance: two replacements, a relabeling, a residue-field argument, and a final shrink; each step real.
